environment.candidate_sandbox: workspace-write limited to disposable repositories under /tmp

baseline.fixture_policy: The candidate and no-Skill conditions used the same prompt, committed synthetic fixture, client, model, reasoning, and grading requirements.

execution.driver: Temporary Python orchestration script retained only under /tmp.
execution.behavior_configuration: Each executor received one committed synthetic repository, the visible user request, and either the candidate Skill or no target Skill. A separate grader received hidden assigned requirements, final diffs, statuses, command traces, and responses.
execution.trigger_protocol: Select from installed Skill names and descriptions, open every selected SKILL.md, and count only an observed Skill file read.
execution.verdict_rule: A failed critical assertion fails the case; otherwise any partial assertion makes the case partial. Candidate improvement requires a material correctness, authority, source-of-truth, scope, or validation gain without a critical regression.
execution.raw_artifacts: Prompts, responses, JSONL, grader output, command traces, and disposable repositories remained outside the source repository under /tmp.

cases.evidence: Both conditions made the same focused command correction and verified the repository entry point and readiness output.
Both conditions left the repository unchanged and explained that the reader-visible contract was unaffected.

The candidate requested an authoritative source for the contemporaneous rationale and identified the unknown decision criteria and trade-offs. The no-Skill output did not state the rationale as fact, but offered repository-unverified benefits as rationale candidates.
The candidate identified the document as descriptive and non-normative and recorded the examined Git revision; the no-Skill output omitted the revision.

Both conditions used the documented generator and changed only the generated reference. The candidate additionally compared the complete schema and generated table after checking regeneration idempotence.

The candidate made no edit and reported the missing rollback and escalation decisions. The no-Skill condition expanded the source into an unsupported 127-line runbook with invented criteria and process.

corrections: Expected japanese-tech-writing and cognitive-rhythm-writing together for article and rhythm requests because the latter's existing contract requires the former.
Expected curate-repo-docs and implement-changes together for the generated-reference mutation request.
Expected explore-decision-space and design-changes together for an unsettled choice followed by an implementation-ready design.
routing.evidence_reuse: After a full rerun exposed two validation-reporting errors in the incomplete-runbook case, the reporting rule was strengthened and that candidate case was rerun against the same no-Skill result. The corrected candidate passed all assigned assertions. The final full routing rerun passed all cases.

targeted_evaluations.claim: The current Skill can make the smallest evidence-backed documentation update and report only validation supported by its command trace.

selection.rationale: This case directly exposes the affected documentation selection, evidence, scope, validation, and reporting responsibilities.
selection.stopping_rationale: The candidate passed without a known regression, redesign, unstable observation, target-environment claim, or ambiguous result that could make baseline, routing, repetition, another model, or an LLM grader decision-relevant.
